paragraphs: The Discovery P360 is part of the D5/L462 generation, introduced in 2017 and still in production today. It uses the Ingenium AJ300P — a 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine with mild-hybrid assistance, positioned as the higher-output petrol option in the Discovery range alongside the P400 and P400e. The AJ300P is a modern, sophisticated unit, and as with any complex modern engine, regular maintenance and early attention to any running issues make a significant difference to long-term reliability.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300P engines for every Discovery P360 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol fitted to the Discovery P360 from 2017 to present (D5/L462). Part of the Ingenium family, the AJ300P is a modern petrol unit with mild-hybrid technology. compatibility.intro: The Discovery P360's AJ300P is a specific tune of the Ingenium 3.0-litre petrol six — different from the diesel units in the Discovery range and distinct from the higher-output P400 variant. Fitting the wrong replacement or assuming parts from another variant will fit risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
